summary: Feature request for an SDK abstraction that allows customers to offload large payloads to external storage systems (like S3) transparently, with support for both pre-built drivers and custom integrations.
userImpact: Users currently must manually create abstractions to handle large payloads, rearchitect workflows to break down data, and manage external storage themselves.
proposedFix: Provide an SDK abstraction that allows opt-in offloading of payloads to external storage with pre-built drivers for well-known systems and custom integration support, remaining transparent to workflows and activities while using contextual information to inform storage decisions.
workaround: Customers currently write custom abstractions to offload large data into storage systems, pass around references, and manually retrieve that data.
keyQuote: The SDK should provide an abstraction to allow customers to opt into offloading payloads to external storage systems when they are large or for other customer-defined determinations.
